# documents

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/atlassian/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/atlassian/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Atlassian-owned native document representation and membership vocabulary.

`connectors_atlassian.documents` is one of connectors_atlassian's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ConfluenceRestApi`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceRestApi` is one of `rest_v1` and `rest_v2`.

### `ConfluenceV1Read`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceV1Read` is one of `content_search`, `page_comments`, `page_get`, `pages_changed`, `space_get`, `space_pages` and `spaces_list`.

### `ConfluenceV2Read`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceV2Read` is one of `page_comments`, `page_get`, `pages_changed` and `space_pages`.

### `CqlSearchSelection`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.CqlSearchSelection` is a record of three fields:

- `cql` — `String`
- `limit` — `Integer`
- `max_body_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(limit >= 1 and limit <= 100)`.

### `DocumentRepresentation`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentRepresentation` is one of `confluence_storage` and `jira_fields_v2`.

### `DocumentScopeKind`

`connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentScopeKind` is one of `confluence_space` and `jira_project`.

Six of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceRestApi`, `connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceV1Read`, `connectors_atlassian.documents.ConfluenceV2Read`, `connectors_atlassian.documents.CqlSearchSelection`, `connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentRepresentation` and `connectors_atlassian.documents.DocumentScopeKind`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
